cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
import json, time, pathlib
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
RUNS = pathlib.Path('/app/runs/food_packing')
RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
(OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
print('CONNECTED')
print(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))

def save_obs(name='obs', obs=None):
    if obs is None: obs = r.get_obs(video='none')
    d = RUNS / name
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(d / f'{cam}.jpg')
    (d/'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
    return obs

def ee(points, video='both', note=''):
    a=np.asarray(points,dtype=np.float32)
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,video=video,note=note)
    res.save(str(RUNS / f'cmd_{int(time.time())}'))
    print('RESULT',json.dumps(res.meta))
    return res

def joints(points, dt=0.2, video='both', note=''):
    a=np.asarray(points,dtype=np.float32)
    res=r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=dt,video=video,note=note)
    res.save(str(RUNS / f'cmd_{int(time.time())}'))
    print('RESULT',json.dumps(res.meta))
    return res

obs=save_obs('initial')
print('INITIAL_PROPRIO',json.dumps(obs.meta.get('proprio')))
PY
